agent.name: Innovation and Disruption Agent
agent.specialty: innovation classification and business-model creative destruction

analytical_question: What is innovative at technology, application, and organization levels, and what may be created or displaced in the business model?
general_et_finding: Generative AI is a substantial general-purpose capability advance in producing and transforming text; a defensible breakthrough-enabling technology, not an invention unique to this organization. Real innovation is demonstrated in implemented use, and commercialization requires separate business evidence.

evidence.claim: Generative AI can automate or assist diverse tasks, but effects depend on task and user expertise.
evidence.source_or_reference: OECD, The effects of generative AI on productivity, innovation and entrepreneurship (2025), https://doi.org/10.1787/b21df222-en
evidence.notes: Research review; not a measurement of either hypothetical organization.

evidence.claim: Generative AI brings distinctive operational risks requiring appropriate human and organizational safeguards.
evidence.source_or_reference: NIST, AI RMF Generative AI Profile (2024), https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
evidence.notes: Risk framework, not evidence of this pilot's failure or success.

evidence.claim: SMEs use generative AI in workforce-related workflows; real benefits vary by context.
evidence.source_or_reference: OECD, Generative AI and the SME Workforce (2025), https://doi.org/10.1787/2d08b99d-en
evidence.notes: Broad survey; does not determine startup revenue impact.

application_finding: The technology can create drafts, but this trial fails the operational-value test: human finishing exceeds baseline. Classify as technical use / unsuccessful pilot, not verified business innovation or commercialization.
organization_specific_finding: No demonstrated savings or demand, so business-model change cannot be established. Business-Model Disruption Judgment: Low (observed pilot); potential future exposure remains uncertain, not proven.
value_opportunity_implication: CREATE/ENABLE: possible future capacity only if prompts, source quality and editing are improved; no observed created economic value in this test.
risk_governance_implication: DISPLACE: no routine production work yet shown to be economically displaced. Early-adoption risk dominates under the negative measured premise; long-run competitor threat unmeasured.
recommendation_management_implication: Pause scaling; diagnose correction categories, improve source approvals, and rerun time-and-quality comparisons before reconsidering.
contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Alternative interpretation: a poor pilot implementation may conceal a useful application; failure to benefit is not evidence generative AI generally lacks breakthrough capabilities.
No observed sponsor/customer value in scenario.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that this described pilot does not demonstrate realized innovation; low confidence about eventual market performance.
change_monitoring_triggers: Measured editing burden below manual baseline
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Do not claim broad market failure or successful commercialization from one pilot.
